notes.title: Off-Road Drive is a part of Fulqrum Publisher Sale!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

We are so happy to announce that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/FulqrumPublishing/sale/publishersale2022]Fulqrum Publisher Sale[/url] just started and Off-Road Drive is a part of it with an amazing discount!
[b]ALL of Fulqrum Publishing's games are discounted by up to 90% for an entire week![/b] The sale ends on October 27.

Besides, we have just launched a brand new game into Early Access, that being [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]. If you have not checked it out yet, now is the perfect time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

Enjoy the sale, buy as many games as possible while they're discounted, play The Pegasus Expedition and don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]Social Media[/url] so you never miss any important info!

notes.title: New Release - Off-Road Drive
notes.notes:
Off-Road Drive is now available on Steam! Purchase before October 7th at 10am Pacific Time and receive the 1C Racing Collection for Free!

Off-Road Drive is the first game ever to deliver a true-to-life, off-road, extreme racing experience. Take part in off-road events through the worst driving conditions featuring a variety of natural obstacles like swamps, rocks, snow and sand.
